title: MCALLEN: NATURAL GROCERS SETS DECEMBER 16 OPENING DATE FOR NEW SOUTH 10TH STREET STORE
text: RGV.me post: Natural Grocers sets Dec. 16 opening for its new McAllen store on South 10th Street.
tldr: RGV.me says Natural Grocers will open its McAllen store on South 10th Street on Wednesday, Dec. 16, its second in the Valley, in a former trampoline park. The company's store page still says 'opening fall of 2026.'
riff: From trampolines to kale. South 10th keeps reinventing itself.

title: MERCEDES: WINGSTOP PLANNING $300,000 FIRST MERCEDES LOCATION AT MERCEDES PLAZA NEAR THE OUTLETS
text: RGV.me post (labeled AI content on the page): Wingstop plans a $300,000 first Mercedes location near the outlets.
tldr: RGV.me (post labeled AI content) says state permits show a $300,000, 3,005-square-foot Wingstop build-out near the Rio Grande Valley Premium Outlets, with construction set for Jan. 11 to March 15, 2027.
riff: Outlet shopping, then lemon pepper. Mercedes is building the perfect Saturday.
